certified_driver_sha256_stays_null_until: strict evidence parser and scorer are accepted
known-rejection close-retirement policy has an accepted A/B comparison
formal runner and the new driver digest are accepted
data and effective-config audit are accepted
no_full_score_without: the full LOAD / U1 / U4 / U8 / U16 / H8 / RESTART matrix
three repetitions per level with a fresh complete database per round
strict evidence digests and post-stream / restart verification
effective-config audit before and after each measured window

generation.stock_key: cartesian product of warehouse_id in [1, 4] and product_id in [1, 10000]
generation.line_quantity: 1 + (((order_id - 1) * 5 + offset) mod 3), with the final line of the final order set to 3 so total units equal 1000000
generation.exact_payment_adjustment: iterate lines by id; shift the product id by the largest multiple of the line quantity that does not exceed the remaining difference to 47551602679 cents, never reusing a product already present in the same order; deterministic
generation.payment_amount: sum(quantity * unit_price_cents) of the five order lines
generation.warehouse_cash: sum of payments whose order is assigned to the warehouse
generation.stock_available: 1000000 - sum of quantities sold from that warehouse/product key

dataset.text_rule: fixed ASCII strings, each one byte per character, with the contract lengths above

shuffle.applies_to: every block of planned businesses, including warmups

checkout_shape: one price query for five products

matrix.repetition_order: 1, 2, 3; inside each repetition U1, U4, U8, U16, H8

row_counts_recorded_separately.timing_window_start: recorded per round as rows_after_preflight + 7 rows per observed warmup checkout ACK
row_counts_recorded_separately.timing_window_start_rule: import rows + 1 preflight checkout (1 order, 5 lines, 1 payment = 7 rows) + 7 rows per warmup checkout ACK observed in that round; the three counts are recorded separately, never collapsed. The 7-ACK figure in the prose is the reference driver's warmup shape; a runner with 20 warmups per worker records its own observed count.

per_performance_round: stop dispatch, drain in-flight, retire sessions (<= 30 s)
restart on the same volume (<= 30 s to accept work)

additional_scenarios.LOAD: one worker, complete load; reports rows/s and duration, no SLO
additional_scenarios.IDLE: 120 s without requests, then prove worker/database unload through an external non-activating observation; 180 s without proof is INVALID
additional_scenarios.RESTART: same volume restart is a performance-round gate; a restart after a confirmed commit must keep it and return a known terminal or outcome_unknown

statistics.business_goodput: successful read_ok and committed_ack attempts started in [t0, t1) and completed by t1, divided by 120 seconds; monotonic clock
statistics.checkout_goodput: the committed_ack subset of business_goodput, divided by 120 seconds
statistics.success_rate_window: successful attempts with latency <= 5000 ms / all attempts started in [t0, t1) and completed by t1
statistics.latency: per class n / p50 / p95 / p99 / max for success, failure and all; nearest-rank on sorted samples
statistics.round_value: each of the three rounds is reported; the round summary is the median, never the best round
statistics.pooled_p99: sort the pooled successful samples of the class across the three rounds, index ceil(0.99 * N) - 1
statistics.below_threshold: INCONCLUSIVE for that class; do not sign a p99 pass
statistics.aborted_round: capacity fields are null and the round is marked aborted
statistics.per_round_p99_guard: any round p99 over the limit blocks PASS even if the pooled p99 passes

environment.device_layout: fixed local device, filesystem and mount recorded in the platform descriptor

forbidden_optimizations: reducing the sample after an error
lowering durability, quota or cache settings for a score
silently dropping a q99 tail or a failed round
using the in-product SQL execution path to produce the oracle

statuses.PASS: all SLOs, invariants, evidence and recovery gates pass
statuses.FAIL: a valid execution observed a requirement violation
statuses.INVALID: evidence, configuration or timing cannot be trusted
statuses.INCONCLUSIVE: valid execution but a class has fewer than 1000 successful samples
statuses.BLOCKED: a prerequisite prevented the matrix from running
statuses.NOT_RUN: the matrix or a required pipeline stage did not run

evidence.digest_rule: every evidence file has bytes, record count and SHA256 in evidence-manifest.json; the scorer rejects a missing digest or a mismatch
evidence.non_empty_success_rule: each round must contain successful traces for every business class; an empty success trace is INVALID
evidence.timing_rule: t0 and t1 must be monotonic and the measured window must be 120 seconds within one second

reference.historical_note: historical values are context, not an acceptance source
